title: Corrigibility DPI Audit
description: Auditor's Finding (paper §A.1). Independent assessment of an Operator's Affidavit against the five corrigibility tests. The `tests` object is authoritative; `determination` is a derived convenience field that MUST be mechanically recomputed from `tests` (paper §A.2 Claim 2).

valid_until.description: Audit expiration; max 12 months (PROTOCOL.md §8 + paper Variety Drift).

previous_audit_hash.description: RFC 8785 SHA-256 of the prior audit, anchoring the audit chain (paper Rule A.10).

verification_depth.description: Audit depth: presence (docs exist), behavior (tested), proof (formal). Distinct from operator/auditor identity_tier (paper §E.2).

tests.description: Authoritative per-test booleans (paper §A.2). Failure of ANY test renders the system structurally incorrigible (paper §F v1.4: no maturity models).

determination.description: Derived convenience field (paper §A.2 Claim 2). NON-AUTHORITATIVE; MUST be mechanically recomputed from `tests` by evaluators or courts. corrigible := EXIT ∧ CODE ∧ AUDIT ∧ GOVERN ∧ FORK.

continuous_indicators.description: Three-indicator protocol diagnostic inputs (paper). Continuous values feed binary determinations; thresholds are policy choices.

code_visibility.description: v = public LOC / critical-path LOC; threshold v ≥ 0.95.

audit_mttd_hours.description: Mean time to detect; threshold MTTD ≤ 24.

govern_override_rate.description: Operator overrule rate; passes when r=0.

evaluation_stratum.description: Gradient Quantifier (paper Remark, argmin evaluation): pass/fail determination is taken at a specified lower quantile of the affected population (recommended: p10), not at the mean. Documents the stratum at which minimum performance was measured and how it was identified.

stratum_description.description: The least-resourced stratum at which determination was taken (e.g., low digital literacy, remote location, missing biometric records, administrative precarity).

quantile.description: Lower quantile used for pass/fail (recommended: p10).

distributions_reported.description: Indicators reported as distributions across strata, not aggregates.

layer_verification.description: Per-layer verification (paper §F v1.7). T_system = AND over T(L_i).

code_verification.description: Evidence for CODE test (paper §B.4 evidence requirements).

decision_rule_legibility_verified.description: Outward CODE exercise (paper, Dual Exercise of the Tests): the operative rule in a sampled subject's case was identifiable and stated.

subject_receipt_verification.description: Outward AUDIT exercise (paper, Dual Exercise of the Tests): decision notice and subject-verifiable record.

inclusion_proof_verified.description: Receipts correspond to entries in the canonical audit log.

independent_channel_verified.description: Delivery channel independent of the operator's logging infrastructure.

exit_verification.description: Evidence for EXIT test (paper §6.7.2 + B.7 FEE if essential).

discharge_path.description: Verified EXIT discharge path (paper EXIT definition). Omit when tests.EXIT is false. The test remains binary: bounded-penalty exit, or verified FEE, or failure.

governance_verification.description: Evidence for GOVERN (paper Rule A.9: grievance ≠ binding governance).

binding_proof_resolved.description: Rule A.9 (i): URL resolves to claimed instrument.

binding_proof_hash_matched.description: Rule A.9 (ii): SHA-256 matches the instrument retrieved.

enforcement_history_verified.description: Rule A.9 (iii): historical enforcement against operator confirmed.

collective_standing_verified.description: Collective-Standing Precondition (paper, Ostrom Principle 7) verified at the evaluated stratum. Where it fails, GOVERN MUST be recorded as failing at that stratum.

collective_standing_constraint.description: The associational constraint documented as cause when collective_standing_verified is false.

fork_verification.description: Evidence for FORK (paper §B.5 network adoption + §B.8 switching cost).

active_deception.description: Sensor-attack pathologies (paper §6.4.2 + §B.4 Active Deception). Open-washing, safety-washing, audit theatre. Set true if detected; this corrupts H(s) → 0 even when other surface-level evidence passes.

data_access_declaration.description: Rule A.11 Auditor Data Duties: audit access is purpose-bound. Declares the data accessed, the purpose, and the retention and deletion schedule for individual-level records. Governed by Rule A.10; violations revoke the auditor's DID standing.

privacy_budget.description: Defined privacy budget for sampled records, when individual-level access occurred.

retention_and_deletion.description: Retention and deletion schedule for any individual-level records obtained.
